model_choice: Position-based TSP formulation. Variables x[i, t] = 1 if site i is visited at position t. Total variables: N^2. For N=30, this is 900 variables, which fits the SA backend comfortably. This formulation naturally encodes the closed tour requirement through the objective and the permutation constraints.
